generator_cmd: printf "%s\n" "$plain" | tools/bsdgames/usr/games/pig | tr -d "\n"  # bsdgames 2.17-35 `pig` (Ubuntu deb, dpkg -x into tools/bsdgames); the newline flushes the last word (pig drops a word still buffered at EOF)
